threat_event: Ransomware delivered by a phishing email encrypts the office desktop and labeling PC and spreads across the flat network to the stuffer HMI, halting Lines 1 and 2; isolating the network cuts the cold-chain gateway
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training; one flat network for office and plant; antivirus alerts reach the MSP only in business hours; backups never restore-tested; machine settings not backed up
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-08; SYS-09; BP-01 to BP-04
likelihood_basis: EV-033 (no security training); EV-017 (one network for office and plant); EV-016 (antivirus alerts in business hours); EV-018 (no restore jobs); EV-010 (machine settings only on the machines)
existing_controls: MSP patching and antivirus; firewall; MFA on named mailboxes
treatment_plan: Plant network separated from office; MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerting; annual training and quarterly phishing simulations; immutable backups with quarterly restore tests; copies of machine settings kept offline

threat_event: An outsider or former worker uses the smokehouse manufacturer's always-on portal connection (shared login, no MFA) to change a cook cycle, producing undercooked ready-to-eat product
threat_source: Outsider with stolen portal credentials; former worker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on vendor connection; one shared portal login with no MFA; no record of cycle changes; no comparison of cycles against approved versions
likelihood_basis: EV-008 (portal always on; one shared login; MFA not turned on); EV-036 (cycle changes not recorded)
existing_controls: Handheld thermometer check of each cook cycle by the Production Supervisor
treatment_plan: Portal connection off except supervised sessions (done 2026-08-12); named manufacturer accounts with MFA; cycle change log with second-person check; monthly comparison of cycles with approved copies

threat_event: The packaging vendor's unattended remote desktop tool on the labeling PC is abused to install ransomware or change label templates
threat_source: Cybercriminal; outsider with the vendor password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Static password written on the PC; tool runs unattended; labeling PC uses a shared administrator login
likelihood_basis: EV-009 (unattended remote desktop tool; static password; shared administrator login); EV-037 (password note at the PC)
existing_controls: MSP antivirus on the labeling PC
treatment_plan: Tool set to on-request sessions (done 2026-08-12); new password; vendor named account with MFA or removal of the tool; sessions logged in the maintenance log

threat_event: A cooler, freezer, or blast chill cooler failure goes unnoticed because the cold-chain gateway is offline or the only alert recipient does not respond, and unsafe product is shipped or inventory is lost
threat_source: Refrigeration failure; gateway or network outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alerts to one phone with no escalation; no alert when the gateway goes offline; gateway on the office network with no backup connection; no written manual log procedure
likelihood_basis: EV-006 (alerts to one phone; no offline alert); EV-007 (3 offline events with no notification); EV-017 (gateway on the office network); EV-033 (no manual log procedure)
existing_controls: Cold-chain alerts for every cooler, freezer, and the truck; refrigeration contractor 4-hour response
treatment_plan: Escalation to the owner and the Maintenance and Sanitation Technician after 15 minutes; gateway offline alert; cellular backup; manual temperature log procedure in the downtime binder

threat_event: FSIS finds electronic CCP and SSOP records unreliable because entries are not attributable and cook-log exports can be edited, and the HACCP system is found inadequate
threat_source: Shared logins and editable exports (process weakness)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared tablet login with typed initials; shared records app administrator; cook logs exported as editable spreadsheets; no documented integrity controls
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (shared tablet login; typed initials; shared default administrator); EV-009 (editable cook-log exports)
existing_controls: Records app edit history; Production Supervisor reviews records before shipment
treatment_plan: Named records app accounts with tablet PINs; named administrators; read-only PDF exports of cook logs; a one-page records integrity procedure

threat_event: After an incident or equipment failure, office data or machine settings cannot be restored in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups never restore-tested; one MSP password can delete them; smokehouse cycles, stuffer HMI settings, and packager recipes are not backed up
likelihood_basis: EV-018 (no restore jobs; one MSP login); EV-010 (machine settings not copied)
existing_controls: Nightly cloud backup of two PCs and the suite (30 days)
treatment_plan: First restore test; immutable 90-day retention; quarterly tests; export machine settings after each approved change and keep them offline

threat_event: A former worker who still knows the shared passwords and smokehouse PIN signs in and changes settings or records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared passwords and the PIN were not changed after the March 2026 departure; no leaver checklist
likelihood_basis: EV-001 (March 2026 departure); EV-035 (shared passwords and PIN unchanged; no leaver checklist); EV-046 (leaver still knew them in July)
existing_controls: Plant doors keyed and alarmed; the leaver returned keys
treatment_plan: Change all shared passwords and the PIN (done 2026-08-12); leaver checklist; replace shared logins with named accounts

threat_event: Business email compromise of the Office Manager's mailbox leads to a fake supplier bank change or redirected customer payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No training on invoice fraud; no call-back rule for bank changes; staff approve MFA prompts without checking
likelihood_basis: EV-035 (2025 bank change attempt; no training); EV-046 (no call-back rule; MFA prompts approved without checking)
existing_controls: MFA on named mailboxes and accounting
treatment_plan: Call-back rule for any bank detail change; MFA number matching; training (R-001)

threat_event: A wrong label template or missing allergen statement is printed and shipped, causing misbranded product in commerce and a recall
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Anyone at the labeling PC can change templates; no change record; first-label check depends on one person; AI camera pilot may be trusted too much
likelihood_basis: EV-036 (template changes not recorded; first-label check by one person); EV-011 (AI camera pilot)
existing_controls: Production Supervisor checks the first label of each run
treatment_plan: Template changes approved by the Production Supervisor with a second-person check; locked approved templates; first-label check recorded in the records app

threat_event: Malware on the flat network exploits the unsupported operating system on the stuffer HMI and stops Line 1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported OS that cannot be patched or run antivirus; same network as office computers
likelihood_basis: EV-010 (stuffer HMI operating system unsupported); EV-017 (same network as the office)
existing_controls: None on the HMI
treatment_plan: Plant network with no internet access for the HMI (R-001); replace the HMI in the 2027 budget; copy of settings kept offline

threat_event: Formulations and HACCP plans are copied from the open shared folder by an outsider using the shared plant mailbox or by a departing worker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Folder open to every suite account; shared plant mailbox without MFA
likelihood_basis: EV-003 (folder open to every suite account); EV-002 (shared plant mailbox without MFA)
existing_controls: MFA on named mailboxes
treatment_plan: Restrict the folder to the owner, Office Manager, and Production Supervisor; MFA or removal of the shared plant mailbox

threat_event: An attacker who compromises the MSP's remote management tool or its unprotected administrator logins reaches every company PC and deletes the backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool can run any command; firewall and backup console logins have no MFA; MSP contract has no security or incident notice terms
likelihood_basis: EV-020 (no security or incident notice terms); EV-017 (firewall login with a password only); EV-018 (backup login with a password only); EV-046 (MSP statement on named technician accounts)
existing_controls: MSP named technician accounts on its platform (MSP statement)
treatment_plan: MFA on firewall and backup console; annual MSP security review; contract terms for 24-hour incident notice and a 4-hour recovery commitment at renewal

threat_event: An internet outage stops cold-chain alerts, the records app, and email ordering for most of a day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet line; no failover; gateway depends on it
likelihood_basis: EV-025 (one internet line, no failover); EV-007 (gateway outages)
existing_controls: Paper forms used informally
treatment_plan: Cellular backup for the gateway (R-004); downtime binder with paper forms; phone hotspot for the office

threat_event: A hurricane causes a multi-day power and network outage; refrigeration and monitoring stop and inventory is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No standby generator; no written hurricane procedure; only one person watches temperatures
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (no standby generator; no hurricane procedure); EV-033 (no contingency plan)
existing_controls: Insurance for spoilage; refrigeration contractor
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the contingency plan (run down inventory, pre-arrange cold storage and a rental generator, manual logs, hold decisions); quote for a transfer switch

threat_event: A phishing click or strange machine behavior is not reported for hours because staff do not know what to report or to whom
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No training; no reporting rule; no incident plan before 2026
likelihood_basis: EV-033 (no training; no incident plan); EV-046 (staff call the Office Manager about most problems)
existing_controls: Staff call the Office Manager about most problems
treatment_plan: Reporting card at every station; annual training; P08 runbook

threat_event: Employee personal information in payroll exports or HR files is stolen from the suite or a PC, requiring Florida breach notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR files in the open shared folder; payroll exports saved to the office desktop
likelihood_basis: EV-003 (HR files in the open folder); EV-035 (payroll exports on the office desktop)
existing_controls: MFA on named mailboxes
treatment_plan: Move HR files to a restricted folder; delete payroll exports after use

threat_event: The AI label and seal camera passes a mislabeled pack or the vendor pushes a model update that changes its behavior without notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No validation protocol; no change notice terms; operators may relax the first-label check
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (no validation protocol or change-notice terms); EV-036 (camera used beside the first-label check)
existing_controls: First-label check by the Production Supervisor; rejects reviewed by a person
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: validation with seeded defects; no reduction of manual checks; contract terms for data use and change notice

threat_event: The records app vendor or cold-chain vendor has an outage or data loss longer than the BIA allows
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SOC 2 or security information from the records app vendor; no paper fallback written down
likelihood_basis: EV-012 (no assurance report from the records app vendor); EV-033 (no written paper fallback)
existing_controls: Cold-chain vendor SOC 2 Type 2 reviewed (P09)
treatment_plan: Request the records app vendor's SOC 2 report or security summary; paper forms in the downtime binder

threat_event: An insider with the shared PIN deliberately changes a formulation or cook cycle to harm consumers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared PIN; no change record or second check; no comparison with approved versions
likelihood_basis: EV-008 (shared PIN); EV-036 (no change record or second check)
existing_controls: Small team; Production Supervisor present for every cook
treatment_plan: Named access and change log (R-002, R-009); monthly comparison of cycles and formulations with approved copies

threat_event: The retail card terminal is tampered with or skimmed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terminal at the front counter
likelihood_basis: EV-023 (provider-managed terminal on its own cellular link)
existing_controls: Provider-managed terminal on its own cellular link; provider monitoring
treatment_plan: Accepted: the provider manages the terminal and no card data touches company systems; staff check the terminal each morning

threat_event: An owner laptop or company phone is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phones receive cold-chain alerts and email
likelihood_basis: EV-014 (owner laptop encrypted; phones with passcode and encryption)
existing_controls: Owner laptop encrypted; phones locked with a passcode and built-in encryption
treatment_plan: Accepted: devices are encrypted and locked; MSP can sign the user out remotely

threat_event: Staff paste formulations, customer lists, or employee data into a public generative AI chatbot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule on AI tools before 2026; the Office Manager uses a chatbot to draft customer emails
likelihood_basis: EV-035 (Office Manager uses public chatbots); EV-043 (what was entered not recorded)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-02 C.2 and POL-04 4.6 prohibit Restricted data in public AI tools; covered in training

threat_event: An attacker on the network signs in to the smokehouse controller's web interface with the manufacturer default administrator password and changes cycles or deletes cook logs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default administrator password on the controller web interface (found in P07 testing on 2026-08-11)
likelihood_basis: EV-SC-7 (default administrator password found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: None at discovery
treatment_plan: Password changed 2026-08-11 and stored in the sealed envelope (done); controller web interface limited to the plant network (R-001)
